name: Konpeki Tou Kumiai ~Guild of Emerald Tower~
original_name: 紺碧塔組合 ～Guild of Emerald Tower～
source:
Master Ladrinado Oz traveled to the Emerald City adventurer guild headquarters to become a hero. Together with the seven companions their adventure begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-may-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
